description:
End your day in paradise with a relaxing sunset sail along the Waikīkī coastline. Step aboard our spacious, stable catamaran and take in panoramic views of Diamond Head as the sky glows in vibrant sunset colors. 

Enjoy smooth sailing, refreshing trade winds, and a full premium bar featuring tropical cocktails, beer, wine, and soft drinks. Light bites are also included to complement your evening on the water. 

This unforgettable cruise blends island beauty and easygoing luxury—ideal for couples, friends, and families alike. 

Check in 20–30 minutes before departure at Kewalo Basin Harbor, Slip F-28, just minutes from Waikīkī and Ala Moana.
what_is_included:
- 1.5-hour scenic sunset sail along the Waikīkī coastline
- Full premium bar with tropical cocktails, beer, wine, soda, and juice
- Light bites and snacks served on board
- Friendly, professional local crew
- Restrooms on board
- Shaded and open-air seating options
- Spectacular views of Diamond Head and the Honolulu skyline
what_is_not_included:
- Optional shuttle available from limited Waikīkī pick up location at an additional fee.
- A 20% tip for the crew is customary and greatly appreciated if you enjoyed your experience. For your convenience, gratuity can be added to your booking at check-out.
highlight_description: Relax and unwind on a sunset sail off Waikīkī. Sip tropical cocktails from our full bar, take in Diamond Head views, and enjoy the magic of golden hour at sea.
check_in_details:
- Departure Time: 5:00 PM
- Arrival Time: Please arrive 20 minutes prior to departure (by 4:40 PM) to allow time for check-in and boarding.
- Location: Kewalo Basin Harbor, Slip F28, just minutes from Waikīkī and Ala Moana.
- Check-In Process: Look for the Hawaii Nautical sign outside our slip.
- Parking: Paid parking is available at Kewalo Basin Harbor. We recommend arriving early to secure a spot and walk to the slip.
- Boarding: Boarding closes 10 minutes before departure. Guests arriving late may not be able to join the tour.
what_to_bring:
- Light jacket or sweater for evening ocean breezes
- Reef-safe sunscreen (no sprays, please apply before boarding)
- Sunglasses and a hat for sun protection
- Reusable water bottle (to help reduce plastic waste — we also have water onboard)
- Optional: Camera or phone for photos and videos... don’t forget to tag us @hawaiinautical!
special_requirements: - Vegetarian and gluten-free meal options are available with advance notice — please notify us at least 24 hours before your trip.
faqs:
- **Do I need sailing experience?**
*No experience is required! Our friendly, professional crew handles everything so you can relax and enjoy the ride.*

- **Are drinks and food included?**
*Yes. Enjoy complimentary refreshments including tropical cocktails, beer, wine, soda, juice, and water from our full premium bar, plus light bites served on board.*

- **Can children join the tour?**
*Absolutely! This sail is family-friendly and safe for kids of all ages. Life jackets are available for everyone.*

- **Where does the tour depart from?**
*We depart from Kewalo Basin Harbor, Slip F-28, just minutes from Waikīkī and Ala Moana.*

- **What time should I arrive?**
*Please check in 20 minutes before departure to allow time to park and board.*

- **Is parking available?**
*Yes. Paid parking is available at Kewalo Basin Harbor. We recommend arriving early to find a spot and enjoy the harbor views.*

- **What should I bring?**
*Bring a light jacket or sweater for the evening breeze, reef-safe sunscreen (no sprays), sunglasses or a hat, and a reusable water bottle. Optional: camera or phone for photos—don’t forget to tag us @hawaiinautical!*

- **What if I get seasick?**
*Our catamaran is large and very stable, which helps minimize motion on the water. If you start to feel unwell, our trained crew is happy to assist and will do their best to make you comfortable throughout the trip.*
